title: Divorced and Carrying the Crown Prince's Cub
author: Wuyue You
synopsis: Meng Shuhe married Shen Qian, the heir of the Duke of Zhenguo’s estate, for three years, only to be rewarded with a notice of divorce. The reason was simply that the Heir despised her for being the true daughter who had grown up wandering in the countryside, completely devoid of proper upbringing. The Heir wanted to marry Meng Ruoli, the fake daughter and the very model of a noble lady raised with proper aristocratic upbringing from the Marquis’s estate, as his wife. After being divorced, Meng Shuhe was drowning her sorrows in alcohol at a countryside estate when she had a one-night stand with Lu Jing, a scholar she had met back in Jiangnan. Upon waking up, Meng Shuhe heard the voice of an infant in her womb calling her mother. It turned out that her son from fifteen years in the future had been reborn back to the very day she conceived him. The child in her womb urged her to flee Chang'an and return to Jiangnan. Only then did Meng Shuhe realize that the baby's father, Lu Jing, was not the ordinary person she had thought him to be...
